cyber_incident.rationale: Ransomware encrypted the core processing environment our provider hosts for us. Member account data and core availability were actually jeopardized without lawful authority.

good_faith_exclusion.rationale: No testing or other authorized activity was under way. The provider confirmed a criminal intrusion.

substantial.rationale: Core, online banking and card authorizations were unavailable for more than four hours. NCUA's Appendix A lists ransomware on critical systems as an example that likely qualifies.

prong_a.rationale: Vital member services (online banking, bill pay, shared branching) were disrupted. Exposure of member data is still being investigated.

prong_b.rationale: The disruption resulted from a cyberattack (ransomware).

prong_c.rationale: The disruption was caused by a compromise of our third-party core processing and data hosting provider.
